label: XT-705A 10G copper to SFP+ media converter
description: 10G media converter with one 100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G auto-negotiating RJ45 port and one 10GBASE-X SFP+ slot. The cage is 10G only (10GBASE-SR/LR, up to 300 m multimode or 60 km single-mode), so multi-gig copper can be carried onto fibre without a 10G switch.
